Class ChongsamVideoScene

java.lang.Object
welcomescene.ChongsamVideoScene
public class ChongsamVideoScene extends Object
A cinematic cut-scene that plays the Chongsam introduction video (/welcomescene/chongsamintro.mp4) as part of the game's opening sequence.

This scene sits between IntroScene and NewsReportScene in the intro flow: 

  IntroScene → ChongsamVideoScene → NewsReportScene → (lobby)

The video plays automatically and the player may press KeyCode.F at any time to skip directly to NewsReportScene. A blinking "Press F to Skip" label is shown throughout.

Usage: 

GameController.getInstance().switchScene(new ChongsamVideoScene().getScene());

  • Constructor Details

    • ChongsamVideoScene

      public ChongsamVideoScene()
      Constructs and fully initialises the Chongsam cut-scene.

      Setup steps performed by the constructor:

      • Creates a 1422 × 800 Scene with a StackPane root
      • Loads and plays /welcomescene/chongsamintro.mp4 via a MediaPlayer as soon as it is ready
      • Registers an end-of-media callback that automatically advances to NewsReportScene when the video finishes
      • Registers a key listener so pressing KeyCode.F skips the video and jumps straight to NewsReportScene
      • Adds a blinking "Press F to Skip" label at the bottom of the screen

  • Method Details

    • getScene

      public javafx.scene.Scene getScene()
      Returns the Scene containing the Chongsam cut-scene UI.

      Pass this to GameController.switchScene(javafx.scene.Scene) or Stage.setScene(javafx.scene.Scene) to display this scene.

      Returns:
      the fully initialised Scene for this cut-scene
